continuity: Go Jun believes Jin Taekyung caused the failure of his Pyeongchang plan and intends to kill him within one year, in Sichuan or Seoul, using a method like the one used against Lee Jungryong.
Go Se-won openly rejects Go Jun's cover-up orders and intends to resign if he survives the coming confrontation with Jin Taekyung.

Go Jun is using Ares Guild's entrenched political, prosecutorial, corporate, and media influence, along with Lee Jungryong's inherited corruption ledger, to protect the Guild and suppress the Pyeongchang scandal.
plot: In Ares Guild's concealed Area A, Go Jun watches live footage confirming that Choi Minwoo survived Behemoth's defeat. He identifies Jin Taekyung as the force that ruined his plan to pit Taekyung and Song Cheonwoo against each other, then plans to cover up Song's disappearance with a prepared double or by framing Song as a lone criminal. He orders Go Se-won to use Ares's political, prosecutorial, and media influence to minimize the Pyeongchang incident.

Go Jun reveals that he inherited an extensive ledger of corruption and weaknesses from Lee Jungryong and believes Ares's entrenched influence will protect him. Go Se-won calls him a monster, warns that Jin Taekyung will not wait a year, and says Ares's network cannot stop Jin. As Ares headquarters begins shaking and emergency sirens sound, Go Se-won opens the office door and states that he will resign if he survives dealing with Jin.
translation_decisions: Use Mount Balwang for 발왕산 and retain Area A for A구역.
Use unpurified S-grade Magic Gems for 정화되지 않은 S급 마정석.
Use Vice Guild Master for 부길드장, Head of Security for 경호팀장, and Team Leader Go for 고 팀장.

active_continuity: Kim Hwajong died after sacrificing himself to restrain Behemoth, and Choi Minwoo remains unconscious after being transported from the battlefield.
Behemoth's Turbid Abyss is a Supreme Peak Magic Gem that absorbed another source of mana and requires purification before use.
Jin Taekyung identifies Go Jun as the culprit behind the Monster Wave and deaths, and Go Jun now believes Jin caused the failure of his Pyeongchang plan.
Jin Taekyung has withdrawn from the Peace Guild and is heading to Ares Guild; Skeleton King remains to protect the Guild and its people.
Cheon Taemin collapsed more than twenty years ago and remains unconscious; his location is unknown, with Area A only suspected.
Song Cheonwoo and Lee Jungryong concealed Taemin's condition and purged those who knew the truth.
Busan's Kraken is dead, but more than one thousand Mermen remain across Haeundae and Gwangalli.
Go Jun seized Song Cheonwoo's children, used an S-grade Magic Gem to cause the Busan Monster Wave, and targeted Choi Minwoo.
Song Cheonwoo was killed by an unidentified monster after falling into an abyss; the object in his pocket released darkness that became light.
Jin Taekyung killed Behemoth with One Annihilation and lost Exhaustion and Internal Energy Depletion through the resulting level-up.
Go Jun intends to kill Jin Taekyung within one year and is relying on Ares's political, prosecutorial, corporate, and media influence plus Lee Jungryong's corruption ledger to protect him.
Go Se-won now openly opposes Go Jun's crimes and cover-up orders, intends to resign if he survives, and has left the office as emergency sirens sound at shaking Ares headquarters.
open_questions: What caused Cheon Taemin's collapse, and what happened during his more than twenty years of unconsciousness?
Is Cheon Taemin actually being kept in Area A of Ares Guild headquarters?
What is the unidentified being involved in Go Jun's plan, and is it connected to the monster that killed Song Cheonwoo?
What was the object Song Cheonwoo kept in his pocket, and what did its release of darkness and light accomplish?
What is the old necklace Go Jun wears, and why does it matter to his plan?
